content.content: 1. Necessity: the guard needs the placing promise and the confinement rule for the path surface it gates — without them, refusing a path it cannot place is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The path refusal is where ownership and the changed set meet the placing; the gate keeps the use sound without testing placement itself.
